scan_linter_check.description:
Flags debug output left in scripts: gs.print(), console.log(), console.debug(), console.trace(), jslog(), alert(), and gs.addInfoMessage() whose literal message starts with debug, test, todo, temp, fixme or xxx. gs.log() is not reported: in global scope it is the standard logging call (use gs.info/gs.debug for new code).
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Debug Statements Left in Code", which matched text (including comments) and also flagged every gs.log().
scan_linter_check.name: JS-001: Debug statements left in code
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Remove debug output before promotion. For diagnostics that should stay, use gs.debug() / gs.info() with a clear source, guarded by a system property where needed.
scan_linter_check.short_description: Debug output in a script: gs.print(), console.log(), jslog(), alert(), etc.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: JS-001: Debug statements left in code
